sensorFps: Actual captured observations. Interpolation does not add camera observations.
inferFps: Processed updates per second. Throughput and end-to-end latency must both be measured.
speed: Target motion on the image plane, not metres per second.
exposure: Shorter exposure may require more illumination.
sensorWidth: Scaling assumes preserved aspect ratio. Recalculate for crop and letterbox.
inputWidth: Used for image-quality estimates. YOLO operation estimate separately assumes 640 input.
targetPixels: Width of the tracked texture in the original image.
maxStep: Editable PoC threshold; not an official TAPIR specification.
maxBlur: Acceptable exposure trail; calibrate using actual footage.
minFeature: Editable resized-feature threshold; not a model guarantee.
watts: Include compute, cameras, carrier, storage and cooling; measure the full system.
streams: Assumes equal FPS per stream. Model different paths separately.
ram: Rejects larger installed-memory configurations; does not prove a model fits.
latency: From capture to usable result, including queues and postprocessing.
viewDistance: Target-to-camera range, independent of near/far avoidance test points.
objectMeters: Pinhole estimate; prefer actual measured pixel boxes when available.
objectHeightMeters: Central, square-pixel projection approximation. Wide-angle/fisheye needs calibration.
audioPlaybackMs: Complete reply includes playback itself. Enter measured/estimated duration of the required answer.
systemReserveGB: OS, decode and application reserve when no local LLM is present; not measured peak memory.
agentRateHz: Request rate. Override streaming ASR/TTS with actual chunk cadence in the task budget.
utilLimit: 0.8 reserves 20% for queues and other work. Only applies to the selected profiled device.
strataResidentGB: Editable envelope. Measure resident experts and mmap working set for the exact quantization/checkpoint.
strataGpuGB: GPU cache and buffers, distinct from minimum physical GPU specification.
jevParamsB: Use exact checkpoint size. B × bits / 8 estimates raw weight GB.
jevBits: Raw weights exclude quantization metadata and runtime overhead.
jevStateGB: Per-request KV, state and workspace; profile on hardware.
sensorHeight: Frame height combined with width. Specify both for 1280×720.
objectWidth: Target width in the original captured frame, not a magnified preview.
objectHeight: Actual target height in original image pixels.
fov: Pinhole approximation near the image centre; use a calibrated model for fisheye optics.
angularSpeed: Actual residual angular speed after gimbal compensation. No perfect stabilization is assumed.
imuSyncMs: Maximum timestamp difference between image and angular-rate measurements.
trackingPoints: Point count affects correlation, attention, temporal state and memory. Profile the exact checkpoint.
smallDefectPx: Minimum acceptable defect in original pixels. Tiling increases model calls.
nearDistance: Near-range test point requiring strict metric accuracy.
nearError: Set an accuracy requirement and separately define percentile or maximum error.
farDistance: Far acceptance test point, also compared against planned stopping range.
farError: Far and near points can have different absolute error budgets.
baselineMm: Distance between stereo camera optical centres.
focalPx: Calibrated camera-matrix fx. Keep separate from the FOV-derived approximation.
disparityError: Geometric planning assumption, not complete model/sensor uncertainty.
robotSpeed: Physical platform speed, distinct from image-plane px/s.
deceleration: Verify with mechanical control, payload and operating conditions.
margin: Additional planning range; does not replace a safety analysis.
weightBits: Raw full-residency weight estimate. Strata uses separate documented configuration gates.
contextTokens: Long context increases prefill, state and cache. Short-dialogue tok/s is insufficient.
kvGB: Manual per-request budget measured for the exact architecture, context and precision.
runtimeGB: LLM activations, buffers and workspace per request. ASR/TTS model cards are budgeted separately.
concurrency: Adds memory and queues. Reprofile concurrent operation; Strata default is sequential requests.
hostReserveGB: OS and resident-service reserve; Strata also retains a documented minimum host configuration.
ssdGB: Include model files, embeddings, indexes and update backups.
speechDeadline: From a fixed endpoint/trigger to first audio or complete answer. Specify timing origin.
vadMs: Waiting for a user pause adds first-audio latency.
asrMs: May overlap VAD; this initial calculation conservatively sums sequential stages.
toolMs: Retrieval and tool return delay; measure variable external API latency separately.
replyTokens: Included for complete-answer acceptance. Add thinking tokens if required.
measuredTps: Zero means unmeasured. Do not substitute another community machine’s result.
iotRttMs: Measure network round-trip, not Wi-Fi PHY rate.
iotEndpointMs: Include endpoint encoding, buffering and playback startup.
iotDeadlineMs: From button/utterance end to text or first audio; measure host/service time separately.
mcuMbps: Use measured compressed stream bitrate, not resolution or nominal USB speed.
mcuWidth: Sensor output width; model input is separately fixed by the chosen example.
mcuHeight: Captured dimensions determine buffers, not model input resolution.
mcuSensorFps: Sustained fresh frames delivered by the camera driver.
mcuFps: Required full-pipeline update rate; published examples are screening references, not guarantees.
mcuBuffers: Count simultaneous capture, processing and queued frames.
mcuPixelBytes: Grayscale 1, RGB565 2, RGB888 3; MJPEG decoding may still need raw buffers.
mcuModelMB: Editable assumption: model, tensor arena and pre/postprocessing peak; camera buffers are separate.
mcuUiMB: Concurrent display, audio and connection buffers; replace with measurements.
mcuReserveMB: System/fragmentation reserve; internal SRAM and DMA must be verified separately.
mcuMeasuredS3: 0 means unmeasured; valid only for the current model, camera dimensions, buffers and precision.
mcuMeasuredP4: 0 means unmeasured; changing model/acquisition configuration clears this value.
iotMaxW: ESP32 endpoint only; budget the local host separately.
iotMeasuredW: 0 means unknown; include concurrent radio, camera, display and audio.
